<b>Aged Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are one of many pilgrims travelling to [[the Citadel]], and can be found resting at the [[Halfway Home]] in [[Greymoor]] before continuing their journey.

== In-game Events ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can meet Aged Pilgrim resting at a table in the Halfway Home. The traveller mentions how lucky they both are to have found this place and complains about the unexpected difficulty of the climb.<ref>Aged Pilgrim: <i>"Tis a blessed bit of luck to find this place, eh, sister? The climb's proved harder than even my best guessin', but there's still some vigour left in these old limbs. Doubly so, now I have a belly full of nectar!"</i></ref> However, with their vigour renewed by a belly full of nectar, they can sense the Citadel calling them upwards.<ref>Aged Pilgrim: <i>"Might have taken me a beat to build the courage, but I can feel it, closer now... the Citadel calling me up."</i></ref>

Once seen, Aged Pilgrim departs the Halfway Home after Hornet rests at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] elsewhere.

== Location ==
Aged Pilgrim can be found at the [[Halfway Home]] in [[Greymoor]] during [[Act 2]], after Hornet speaks with [[Creige]] at least once and meets [[Lace]] in the [[Choral Chambers]].
